content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Greenville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—no work experience necessary. This makes the credential ideal for career-changers and early-career professionals entering Greenville's healthcare, manufacturing, utilities, and energy sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format compresses the required contact hours into a focused schedule, allowing you to earn your education while maintaining your current job.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with the Project Management Institute and pay the exam fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through the application process to ensure your eligibility is confirmed before you sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to review PMBOK® Guide concepts and practice questions. Our instructors provide targeted support so you approach test day confident and ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: Renew every three years by earning professional development units through continuing education, work experience, or volunteer service. Staying current keeps your credential active and demonstrates ongoing commitment to your project management career.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
